_comment: Lane -> Chrome browser pin. Read by scripts/chrome-pin.sh.
WHY THIS EXISTS: Claude Code stores exactly ONE browser pin, globally, at
~/.claude.json .chromeExtension.pairedDeviceId. With 2+ browsers connected and no pin
match, the Chrome MCP forces an AskUserQuestion before every browser action.
A pin that matches a connected browser makes that prompt disappear entirely.
requirePairedDevice exists in the binary but the CLI never provides its getter, so it
cannot be used (verified Claude Code v2.1.259).
deviceIds come from list_connected_browsers. They are stable per Chrome profile.

jaques.note: Snorkel — authenticated Snorkel session lives in Browser 2
